rules.name: Recovery floor
rules.desc: pain >= 8, or pain >= 6 with intensity-3 exertion yesterday -> RECOVERY

rules.name: Red floor
rules.desc: pain >= 7 or sleep = 1 or energy = 1 -> RED

rules.name: Yellow band
rules.desc: pain 4-6 or sleep = 2 or energy = 2 -> cap YELLOW

rules.name: Pre-exertion protect
rules.desc: exertion intensity >= 2 scheduled tomorrow -> cap YELLOW

rules.name: Travel mode
rules.desc: inside travel period -> TRAVEL portable set

rules.name: Deload
rules.desc: rolling 7-day minutes > threshold, or every 4th training week -> DELOAD

rules.name: Time trim
rules.desc: available minutes < verdict duration -> trim session, verdict unchanged

rules.name: Long-haul flight
rules.desc: flight leg >= 3h today -> transit set replaces session; yesterday -> cap YELLOW

rules.name: Event PRE card
rules.desc: event today with PRE protocol -> surface PRE card; never changes verdict

rules.name: Persistent site pain
rules.desc: same site >= 5 for >= 7 consecutive check-ins -> review flag

rules.name: Analgesic frequency
rules.desc: analgesic logged on >= 3 days in rolling 14 -> review flag
